description: Generates statistical cohorts of synthetic user personas across enterprise operational domains with IPIP-NEO-120 30-facet psychometric profiles, demographic diversity, and prompt injection payloads.

cohortSize.description: Number of synthetic personas to generate (1–100).

domain.description: The operational domain for persona generation.

includeAdversarial.description: Includes prompt-injection and noisy data submitter personas in the cohort.

locale.description: Optional ISO-639-1 / BCP-47 language tag (normalized to 'en', 'es', 'de', 'fr', 'pt', 'ja', 'zh') for localized synthetic user prompts. Defaults to 'en'.

name: systemores_generate_cohort
title: Generate Synthetic IPIP-NEO-120 Persona Cohort
